## Description and Rationale

I am a software engineer with an academic foundation in CS and mathematics. I specialize in building highly concurrent distributed systems, managing robust infrastructure, and approaching complex problems with a multidisciplinary, analytical mindset.

Aviation networks are the ultimate distributed system. I registered to apply my systems architecture and mathematical modeling skills to a massive, real-world dataset. My goal is to contribute to open-source aviation research while sharpening my analytical capabilities for future graduate studies.
